thread:
tina: heads-up — planning a low-exposure v2 rollout during the 02:00 UTC change window. this is a shadow+opt-in stage: traffic is mirrored to v2 for telemetry, 1% routed if customers explicitly opt-in via header. posting quick runbook.

deploy-bot: scheduled job created: job_id=rb-2026-06-10-01, mirror=true, optin_route=1%, window=02:00-03:30 UTC. I'll emit snapshots to the console and post status here.

marco: good. two docs asks: 1) release-note blurb to explain mirror vs live routing; 2) add explicit example for pinning route back to v1 via API.

jia: on it — drafting a short migration note. calling the header `x-rd-version` in docs to avoid clashing with internal headers. older SDKs will keep routing to v1 by default unless they set the header.

emily: rollback criteria suggestion: sustained error_rate >= 0.7% for 3m OR 95p latency increase > 30% relative to baseline for 5m -> immediate auto-pin. Also flag a token_cost_delta > +30% for 15m for manual review.

marco: add a streaming-sanity check: contiguous missed frames > 2% over 5m -> ops-eyes. If stream reconnect rate spikes > 0.5% -> escal.

tina: probe plan: `mirror-probe-v2` doing mirrored request + schema validation. config: interval=20s, fail_threshold=4, ignore_auth_401_for=90s. failure_policy: 4 fails -> auto-pin.

ops-bot: infra note: canary pool prewarm disabled for mirror-mode (since it's non-serving), but autoscale hooks are enabled for when we flip to live. hooks -> #eng-oncall.

emily: pinlist for this stage: internal telemetry tenants only: ["int-observe","perf-lite"]. no paid tenants in this mirror run.

tina: deploy command (ops approved):
```
deploybot start --job rb-2026-06-10-01 \
  --route /api/v2 \
  --mirror true \
  --optin 1 \
  --probe mirror-probe-v2 \
  --fallback-policy auto-pin-on-failure
```

deploy-bot: mirror run started. telemetry mirror enabled, opt-in routing at 1% for headers matching `x-rd-version: v2`. snapshots every 2m under job page.

marco: monitors to watch: mirror_error_rate, mirror_95p_latency_rel, stream_reconnect_rate, token_cost_delta. alerting: error_rate > 0.4% for 90s -> ops-eyes, >=0.7% for 3m -> auto-pin.

emily: owners: tina (release lead), marco (sre), jia (docs/comms). sam on-call fallback if needed.

jia: release-note draft: "v2 rollout begins as mirrored telemetry in quiet window. customers must opt-in with header `x-rd-version: v2` to route live. SDKs <2.2 will not opt-in automatically." linking PR now.

ops-bot: first mirror snapshot uploaded: https://console.redwood/inference/canary/rb-2026-06-10-01/snapshots/1

marco: 18m update: mirrored 95p latency +10% relative; absolute 95p 480ms. error_rate 0.09% on mirror traffic. no stream anomalies.

emily: token_cost_delta measuring +8% so far. not a blocker.

jia: docs PR merged — added FAQ on how to test with cURL and SDK examples. snippet: `curl -H \"x-rd-version: v2\" https://api.redwood/...`

marco: 50m update: metrics steady. proposing to open opt-in to 5% for deeper telemetry in next hour, still mirror-first.

tina: proceed with opt-in expansion to 5% after 1h stable. re-run command with `--optin 5`.

deploy-bot: opt-in expansion applied: optin=5%. automations continue to monitor and auto-pin on failure.

emily: 2h final check: mirror telemetry healthy. plan to schedule a live-ramp for a future change window after stakeholder comms and a longer observation period. thanks all. :thumbsup:
